title: Bedrock mound inside the Great Pyramid is taller than believed
summary: Jeffrey tells of Bedrock mound inside the Great Pyramid is taller than believed, about an unknown time at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But in my opinion, the bedrock mound is actually much taller than we think.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt was built over a natural mound of bedrock, and that this mound is much taller than people think. He offers it as his own opinion, and if true it would change how people understand the way the pyramid was built.
